competency_questions: Which single paper is cited by the largest number of other papers in this corpus?
If two papers tie for the highest internal citation count, how is the single 'most influential' paper determined?
Does a paper that is cited only by papers outside the corpus contribute to its influence score here?
definition: The single paper in the corpus with the highest number of citing papers, counted over all papers in the corpus.

measure.filter: rank papers by count of distinct citing papers in the corpus

needs: cites edges between papers in the corpus
paper identifiers and titles to break ties and label the answer

scope.citations: cites edges between papers both of which are in the corpus

title: Most influential paper by internal citation count
